SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT CSTMR_ID, QUOTA_RE_NO, QUOTA_RE_SEQ, QUOTA_RE_RND FROM KEPCON.KEPMPRQ02 WHERE CSTMR_ID IN ('KRKOLO0001C001','KRKOLO0002C001','KRKOLO0003C001') AND SND_CHK = 'Z' AND PROCE_STATE_CD IN ('RE04','RE05 ','RE06 ') GROUP BY CSTMR_ID, QUOTA_RE_NO, QUOTA_RE_SEQ, QUOTA_RE_RND
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT NVL(RQ02.IF_QUOTA_RE_NO ,' ') AS RFQ_NO , F_SPLIT(RQ02.IF_QUOTA_RE_SEQ,'-',1) AS RFQ_LINE_NUM , GETALANCINFO(RQ03.SPPLR_ID,'BIZ_NO') AS VENDOR_CODE , GETALANCINFO(RQ03.SPPLR_ID,'ALANC_NM') AS VENDOR_NAME , NVL(RQ03.QTY , 0 ) AS QUANTITY , NVL(RQ03.SLS_UNTPRC , 0 ) AS UNIT_PRICE , NVL(RQ02.ADMNCMPY_NOTE ,' ') AS SEND_REMARK FROM KEPCON.KEPMPRQ02 RQ02, KEPCON.KEPMPRQ04 RQ04, KEPCON.KEPMPRQ03 RQ03 WHERE RQ02.CSTMR_ID = '$G_RS.CSTMR_ID$' AND RQ02.QUOTA_RE_NO = '$G_RS.QUOTA_RE_NO$' AND RQ02.QUOTA_RE_SEQ = '$G_RS.QUOTA_RE_SEQ$' AND RQ02.QUOTA_RE_RND = $G_RS.QUOTA_RE_RND$ AND RQ02.PROCE_STATE_CD IN ('RE04','RE05','RE06') AND RQ02.QUOTA_RE_NO = RQ04.QUOTA_RE_NO AND RQ02.QUOTA_RE_SEQ= RQ04.QUOTA_RE_SEQ AND RQ02.QUOTA_RE_RND= RQ04.QUOTA_RE_RND AND RQ03.QUOTA_RQ_NO = RQ04.QUOTA_RQ_NO AND RQ03.QUOTA_RQ_SEQ= RQ04.QUOTA_RQ_SEQ AND RQ03.QUOTA_RQ_RND= RQ04.QUOTA_RQ_RND AND RQ03.QUOTA_RQ_RND = 1 AND RQ03.SLS_UNTPRC ^= 0 ORDER BY RQ02.CSTMR_ID, RQ02.QUOTA_RE_NO, RQ02.QUOTA_RE_SEQ
UPDATE KEPMPRQ02 SET SND_CHK = 'Y' , SND_DATM= SYSDATE WHERE CSTMR_ID = '$G_RS.CSTMR_ID$' AND QUOTA_RE_NO = '$G_RS.QUOTA_RE_NO$' AND QUOTA_RE_SEQ = '$G_RS.QUOTA_RE_SEQ$' AND QUOTA_RE_RND = '$G_RS.QUOTA_RE_RND$'
UPDATE KEPMPRQ02 SET SND_CHK = 'E' , SND_DATM= SYSDATE WHERE CSTMR_ID = '$G_RS.CSTMR_ID$' AND QUOTA_RE_NO = '$G_RS.QUOTA_RE_NO$' AND QUOTA_RE_SEQ = '$G_RS.QUOTA_RE_SEQ$' AND QUOTA_RE_RND = '$G_RS.QUOTA_RE_RND$'
